comparison: Perfect agreement on validation of conditional knockout alleles (C27-C122). Both evaluations recognize the rigorous molecular characterization through multiple methods (Southern, Northern, RT-PCR, Western blot). All reviewers confirmed the validation was thorough and convincing.

Strong agreement on DAT-Cre specificity (C29, C34). Both evaluations accept the 99% colocalization data with TH+ neurons in SNpc. OpenEval also addresses C51-C52 (absence in LC), which peer reviewers implicitly accepted through R7 discussion.

Complete agreement on normal health parameters (C2, C30, C35, C67, C75). Both evaluations emphasize this as a key distinction from germline DKO mice, confirming that neurodegeneration is not secondary to poor health.

Full consensus on progressive DA neuron loss (C3, C31, C38-C44). Both evaluations accept the stereological quantification showing normal counts at 15M and significant loss at 20M. All reviewers affirmed this as the core finding with rigorous statistical analysis.

Agreement on increased apoptosis (C4, C45, C46). Both evaluations accept the ~2-fold increase in active Caspase-3+/TH+ cells as evidence for the mechanism of DA neuron death. Peer reviewers noted this as a topic for future mechanistic investigation.

Agreement on striatal TH reduction (C6, C47-C49). Peer Reviewer 1 specifically requested this data and confirmed satisfaction with the results showing TH decrease paralleling SNpc neuron loss. Both evaluations note the temporal progression from 15M to 24M.

Complete agreement on LC sparing (C50-C52). Both evaluations recognize this as important evidence for regional specificity and cell-autonomous interpretation, with Reviewer 1 explicitly noting LC neurons are not lost and do not express DAT.

Agreement on microgliosis (C5, C56-C60). Both evaluations accept the progressive increase in Iba1+ cells as a secondary response. OpenEval notes the interpretation of cell-extrinsic response is somewhat speculative; peer reviewers accepted the finding without challenge.

Strong agreement on absence of autophagic vacuoles (C32, C53-C55). Both evaluations emphasize this as a key distinction from germline DKO mice. OpenEval includes C33 comparing to germline mice; peer reviewers explicitly noted this difference. Both note the speculation about microglia responsibility (C55).

Agreement on motor coordination deficits (C7, C61-C65). Both evaluations accept the behavioral data showing deficits in 10mm beam walk at 10M preceding neurodegeneration. Peer Reviewer 3 noted new data addresses functional impact concerns, implicitly accepting the findings.

Agreement on aged mouse behavioral limitations (C68-C74). Both evaluations accept that 22-month-old mice of both genotypes perform poorly, making the test suboptimal at this age. Neither evaluation challenged this interpretation, though peer reviewers did not specifically comment.

Strong agreement on cell-autonomous neurodegeneration conclusion (C8, C88). Both evaluations affirm this as the central finding. OpenEval includes C46 in this result; peer reviewers emphasized this resolves previous uncertainty about whether DKO neurodegeneration was cell-autonomous.

Agreement on uncertainty regarding PD relevance (C9, C92, C107-C108). Both evaluations rate this as UNCERTAIN. Reviewer 2 raised significant concern about construct validity since loss-of-function mutations are tolerated in humans. OpenEval notes the connection to gain-of-function mutations is not directly tested.

Agreement on ventral midbrain LRRK reduction (C36). Both evaluations accept the Western blot validation showing selective reduction in ventral midbrain. Reviewer 1 initially questioned LRRK1 expression levels but ultimately accepted functional relevance in revision.

OpenEval evaluated extensive background and literature review claims (C1, C10-C25, C76-C78, C83-C106) as SUPPORTED. Peer reviewers did not explicitly evaluate these background/contextual claims, focusing instead on experimental findings.

OpenEval evaluated acknowledgment of limitations and future directions (C79-C82) as SUPPORTED. Peer reviewers did not separately evaluate these discussion points, though they raised similar questions about mechanisms and future experiments.

OpenEval evaluated qualitative morphology assessment (C37) as SUPPORTED with appropriate caveats about limited analysis. Peer reviewers did not specifically comment on DA neuron morphology in remaining neurons.
OpenEval evaluated gene/protein structure descriptions (C109-C111) as SUPPORTED factual statements. Peer reviewers did not separately evaluate these descriptive claims about the targeting strategy.
